notes.title: Drift Desert Race Free Trial
notes.notes:
Discover the thrill of desert racing in Drift Desert Race!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172961/73d82101fe46505ae264775fcf68a08c75760584.png[/img]

For a limited time, you can try the game for free. Get behind the wheel and face thrilling challenges that test your precision, navigate dynamic tracks with unique obstacles, and race to set the best times. Hone your drifting skills, master advanced techniques, and experience the power of high-performance racing machines.
This free trial is available for a limited time — download and play now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172961/5ac26ea8bc482e042c57dad7c496e752189e267b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Urban Drift
notes.notes:
Introducing the Drift Desert Race Update!

[b]Desert Map Revamp[/b]: We've reworked the Desert map for a better racing experience.
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2437103466158239335/6116654706423B02CAE5B06DFE6AF5FAAE8FCC20/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

[b]New Map: City: [/b]Drift through the city streets with expanded opportunities for stylish maneuvers!
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2437103466158235483/3A806911B64D83F22CD0ED083C412DB9BF5A3A5E/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

[b]Collider Fixes[/b]: Addressed invisible obstacles across maps and improved spawn collisions with new cars.

[b]Optimization Boost[/b]: Enhanced performance for smoother gameplay.

[b]Let the drifting begin![/b]

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2437103466158230506/B2B129E2AF2A67EDBFD6AB5B3A1039FEC98D3335/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]
